oneOf_readonly.title: OneOf readonly
oneOf_readonly.description: An example of a readonly oneOf construction with readonly option set in the UI schema

oneOf_with_not_applicable.title: OneOf with not applicable option
oneOf_with_not_applicable.description: An example of an optional oneOf construction with the allowNotApplicable option and an optional NotApplicableLabel. These options only apply if the parent property of the oneOf construction is optional.

oneOf_with_radio.title: OneOf with radio
oneOf_with_radio.description: An example of a oneOf construction with radio and horizontal options set in the UI schema

oneOf_with_selectbutton.title: OneOf with selectbutton
oneOf_with_selectbutton.description: An example of a oneOf construction with selectbutton and notApplicableLabel options set in the UI schema

oneOf_branch_ui_schemas.title: OneOf with branch UI schemas
oneOf_branch_ui_schemas.description: An example of a oneOf construction with per-branch UI schemas that hide different fields. A string label on each branch UI schema overrides the schema title used for the radio options.

oneOf_hide_branch.title: OneOf with a hidden branch and custom labels
oneOf_hide_branch.description: An example of a oneOf construction that hides the middle schema branch (User) with false and relabels the remaining options. Prefill matches the third branch so the original combinator index is preserved.
